text.aria-label: Title text 'The trailing windows add little to the forecast's response to an injected load shift; the day-ago and week-ago lags add more. Leak: change in the median forecast, points of capacity; smaller is better. Seed 0, five folds, 511's stress world.'

the day-ago and week-ago lags add more. Leak: change in the median forecast,
